text:
alex: kicking off thread — ACME POC capacity questions. they expect 800 rps peak for chat API during promos. asking about reserved GPUs vs burst credits.

maya: thanks alex. do we have their average seq len and modal prompt sizes? that affects batching/throughput.

alex: they said avg request ~220 tokens, few long runs ~2k tokens. mix 70% chat, 30% embeddings.

jordan: for 800 rps @220 tokens we should estimate tokens/sec: 800 * 220 ≈ 176k tokens/s. depending on model size/quant we might need ~6-8 A100-equivalent GPUs reserved for steady, plus burst lanes.

samir: +1. also ask if they need strict latency SLOs (<200ms p50). latency target changes autoscale vs reserved sizing.

alex: they want p95 < 800ms, p50 < 200ms. willing to pay for reserved capacity if predictable.

maya: ok with those p95 constraints, we should propose: reserved pool sized for 500 rps steady, burst credits for up to 300 rps peak, prewarm KV caches during promo windows. add autoscale policy with fast ramp (30s) and queue depth throttles.

jordan: example autoscale snippet to propose:```json
{"min_replicas":4,"max_replicas":12,"scale_metric":"rps","target":100}```

samir: also highlight model variants — recommend a quantized 13B variant for cost-efficiency and a fp16 70B for fallbacks. routing policy: prefer quantized, fallback to fp16 when queue > 50 and latency rising.

maya: pricing question: they asked unit cost delta for reserved vs burst. alex can you route to finance for a 12-month reserved quote + burst credit addon.

alex: looping in finance separately, but quick calc: reserved reduces per-token by ~22% vs pure burst at current SKUs. will get exact numbers.

security-bot: security questionnaire flagged: "Do you support VPC peering and KMS?" — ACME requires KMS + audit logs.

samir: we support customer-managed KMS in Private and Dedicated. for Hosted we offer envelope encryption + audit exports. note this in proposal and include Private deployment option for PHI.

jordan: ops note — preheat plan: schedule a KV warmup job 10 minutes before promo, with synthetic prefix hits to populate cache. preheat throughput: ~200 rps for 5min per shard.

maya: operational runbook blurbs: - preheat job (10m) - burst credit policy (300rps, 15min windows) - canary rollout if new model - fallback route to smaller model when latency >1s.

alex: client asked about queueing behavior when autoscale lags. we should recommend request rate limiter at edge with HTTP 429 + Retry-After and a graceful degrade path returning cached answers for high-cost queries.

jordan: send them an appendix with expected latency curves: quantized13B: ~120ms/token on p50 per GPU, fp1670B: ~60ms/token but higher cost. include cost/latency table.

maya: final ask — can we schedule a 30-min POC preflight call tomorrow with ACME ops to walk through preheat and security checklist? alex to confirm availability. :calendar: 

alex: i'll DM scheduling. tagging @samir to prepare the security bullet points for the call.

samir: noted — will prepare KMS diagram + audit log sample.

ops-bot: deploy check: reserved-pool plan doc created: /ops/poc/acme/reserved-plan-v1 — review in #eng-ops.

alex: thanks all. i'll draft the proposal: reserved 6 GPUs steady, burst credits to 300 rps, autoscale policy (min 4 max 12), KV preheat, fallback routing, security appendix. sending draft by EOD. :thumbsup:
